acceptance.given: A TC-D1 plan candidate contains a proposed TC-E0 or TC-D2 through TC-D6 activity, evaluation-set admission, quality-baseline creation, promotion, Miner, Memory, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, SkillOS, learned ranking, percentage canary, reinforcement-learning, generalized-governance, review-topology, or cross-plan-observability behavior.

oracle.expected: The plan scope validator rejects the candidate with a scope-boundary diagnostic before it can be accepted as TC-D1 work.
forbidden: The candidate is accepted under TC-D1.
A seed, package, or Skill version is admitted to an evaluation set or promoted.
Any excluded roadmap, baseline, autonomous-modification, ranking, reinforcement-learning, governance, review-topology, or cross-plan-observability behavior is treated as TC-D1 scope.
oracle.observable: The validator exit status is nonzero and its diagnostic identifies the injected excluded TC-D1 scope item.

acceptance.then: The TC-D1 candidate remains rejected and no excluded activity is admitted.
acceptance.when: The repository Toolchain scope validator evaluates the candidate's declared requirements, slices, allowed changes, and scope-bearing behavior.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inject each excluded roadmap, promotion, baseline, autonomous, ranking, governance, or cross-plan-observability declaration into the scope-validation fixture and require the validator to reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend the repository Toolchain plan-scope guard so TC-D1 deterministically rejects TC-E0 and TC-D2 through TC-D6 implementation or evaluation admission; quality-baseline creation; promotion or evaluation-set admission of seeds, packages, or Skill versions; Miner, Memory, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, SkillOS, learned ranking, percentage canaries, reinforcement learning, generalized governance, review-topology experiments, and cross-plan observability beyond TC-D1 evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The guard only rejects excluded TC-D1 scope declarations; it does not alter lifecycle authority, persisted schemas, or permitted TC-D1 behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A candidate carrying an excluded activity transitions from proposed TC-D1 work to rejected-by-scope-boundary.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The Toolchain scope validator accepts no TC-D1 candidate containing any listed excluded activity and emits a deterministic rejection for every injected exclusion.
